translation_notes: SDO.domainIncludes -> sdo:domainIncludes; that single namespace term is the region's only RDF notation, and the region is read-only, so no g{} island appears

the `from rdflib.namespace import (DC, DCTERMS, ..., VANN)` block is replaced by a single @prefix sdo: declaration; the thirteen other namespaces were imported by the enclosing module but are unused in the region (the draft declared all fourteen and kept the import block)

context shims: supermodel_model.py (verbatim copy of pylode/profiles/supermodel/model.py, BSD 3-Clause) and supermodel_query_common.py (verbatim copy of query/common.py, with its model import retargeted at the local shim) so the region's two import lists resolve; only module paths changed, identical for both sides

driver passes db=None: the region forwards the Dataset to get_class without touching it, and the harness compares any rdflib Graph argument by isomorphism, which rdflib.compare cannot do on a quad-yielding Dataset
note: model.Class.__eq__ only compares iri, so the returned list is compared on IRIs; the graph arguments are additionally compared by isomorphism
